articles.title: Apothecary Crust
articles.summary: Dark green base with faint magenta and teal shimmer, fine crystalline sparkle across a satin surface. A murky dark-green car with a grainy, mossy or patinated-copper crust; teal patches show as slightly cooler cloud.

Up close: Dark bottle-green ground crawling with pixel-fine charcoal ring squiggles, like crusted salt, with brighter green and teal blobs 10-25 px wide scattered through. Very busy at the pixel level; no big shapes. From a distance: A murky dark-green car with a grainy, mossy or patinated-copper crust; teal patches show as slightly cooler cloud. articles.summary: Near-black charcoal with faint khaki speckle, dense knobbly grain, satin with medium sparkle. Reads as dark charcoal with a faint olive-khaki cast, like wet asphalt or dark camo cloth; grainy, quiet, nearly black.
articles.what: Knucklebones thrown and settled where they fell, packed tight, each knobbed at both ends. A FRACTURED RELICS finish. Up close: Charcoal-black field covered in tiny knobbly dog-bone and squiggle blobs, 3-6 px, in khaki-olive and muddy green, outlined in black, packed tightly like gravel or coarse asphalt. Dark overall, low contrast. From a distance: Reads as dark charcoal with a faint olive-khaki cast, like wet asphalt or dark camo cloth; grainy, quiet, nearly black.
